scope: ONLY ui.chat.pickers at 30fa931f77, all 720 keys, English source and en context sidecar read side by side with the Urdu catalogue. Every value changed by the remediation since the prior audit was re-checked semantically (20 values); the 34 chrome keys the completion wave re-added were byte-identical to the prior audited values and were also read. method: Read 720/720 Urdu values against the English catalogue and the en context sidecar.
Parsed every message as ICU with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser: arguments, plural and select arms, number/date skeletons, tags and pound tokens compared branch by branch.
Rendered all 27 plural messages with IntlMessageFormat at counts 0, 1, 2, 5, 21 and 1.5; checked the tally composition `${term.count} ${term.label}` and table-pager composition.
Checked Urdu CLDR categories one/other in every plural message; reviewed every locale-added arm.

RTL pass: no manual bidi controls, Latin islands (code spans, flags, paths, model ids, product names) kept byte-identical and in source order, Urdu punctuation (۔ ، ؟ ؛) in prose, Latin punctuation only inside code/numbers, no Arabic-Indic digits, no Hindi danda.
Checked NFC, invisible characters, duplicate keys, key-set/order parity, identical values, and glossary/style-guide terminology against other Urdu catalogues.
Re-checked the prior round-1 open findings (UR-CAN-PICKERS-03 and -17) at the current bytes; re-checked UR-CAN-PICKERS-01's related key after the remediation.

findings.reason: «نیٹو» is the Urdu name of NATO, a false friend for «native»; the caption names the model's native facts (context role), not an alliance. The last remediation fixed native_inputs/native_outputs to «مقامی» but left this related key, so the same English «native» now maps to two different terms on adjacent model-detail rows. Prior UR-CAN-PICKERS-01 named this key as related.
findings.evidence: abb405770d changed this key to «اصل تفصیلات — {name}» and its commit message names «اصل details» as the intended term; 8f68640625 reverted it to «نیٹو تفصیلات — {name}», and the cb8b9bab6c merge kept the reverted value. native_inputs/native_outputs remain «مقامی».

findings.current: فراہم کنندہ کی فہرست نہیں مل سکی۔ نیچے والی قطاریں {value} ہیں؛ فراہم کنندگان سے تازہ کریں دوبارہ کوشش کرتا ہے۔
findings.proposed: فراہم کنندہ کی فہرست نہیں مل سکی۔ نیچے والی قطاریں {value} ہیں؛ «فراہم کنندگان سے تازہ کریں» دوبارہ کوشش کرے گا۔
findings.reason: The sentence uses the button's imperative label as a bare grammatical subject, so it reads «Refresh from providers tries again» with no quote or connector — ungrammatical. Quoting the label (as the Russian does with «…») and using the future «کرے گا» makes it a statement about the control.
findings.evidence: Button key destination_pickers.refresh_from_providers = «فراہم کنندگان سے تازہ کریں»; this sentence is the only place that label is quoted, and it is not delimited.

findings.source: Copies this conversation up to and including {value}. Everything after it is left behind, and the original keeps running and is not modified.
findings.current: یہ گفتگو {value} تک، بشمول اس کے، نقل کرتا ہے۔ اس کے بعد کا سب پیچھے رہ جاتا ہے، اور اصل گفتگو چلتی رہتی ہے اور نہیں بدلتی۔
findings.proposed: یہ گفتگو {value} تک، بشمول اس کے، نقل کر دی جاتی ہے۔ اس کے بعد کا سب پیچھے رہ جاتا ہے، اور اصل گفتگو چلتی رہتی ہے اور نہیں بدلتی۔
findings.reason: The explicit subject «یہ گفتگو» is feminine but the verb is masculine «کرتا», and the English subject is the fork action rather than the conversation. The passive «نقل کر دی جاتی ہے» fixes both the agreement and the agent.
findings.evidence: Catalogue treats گفتگو as feminine throughout (e.g. «گفتگو نہیں بنائی جا سکی», «اصل گفتگو نہیں بدلتی»).

findings.reason: Every other goal string uses «ہدف» (goal), while «مقصد» also renders «Purpose» in session_panel.purpose, collapsing two concepts on adjacent screens; the prior round-1 minor remains open at the current bytes.
findings.evidence: abb405770d changed both keys to ہدف; 8f68640625 reverted them to مقصد. All other goal strings in the current file use ہدف: destination_pickers.goal = «ہدف», set_goal = «ہدف مقرر کریں», uses_the_standing_goal = «مستقل ہدف استعمال کرتا ہے»; session_panel.purpose = «مقصد».
